category: free premium link generator with optional paid tier plus a Telegram bot

free_tier.stated: 'Sim - gratis para usar, sem precisar de conta ou cadastro. O plano gratuito e mantido por anuncios; um plano premium opcional remove os anuncios e o limite diario.'
free_tier.notes: A daily unlock count exists on the free plan; the number is not published on the Portuguese page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: files stay on the third-party host, whose own cap applies. debridr publishes no per-file size.

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage. The Portuguese page states the output is 'um link HTTP normal e resumivel' and says nothing about how long it lives.

egress.terms: 'sem limite de velocidade' (no speed limit) and 'Baixe seu arquivo na velocidade maxima' on the free plan; the only free cap named is a daily unlock count, which premium removes.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited speed; daily unlock count capped (number unpublished)

interface_detail: Web form plus a Telegram bot, '@debridrbot', where a link is pasted into the chat and the unlocked link comes back. Batch unlocking exists ('use o desbloqueio em lote'). No public API is documented.
tooling: The output is a resumable HTTP link that JDownloader or any manager can take, stated explicitly: 'abra a pagina de download e copie o Link direto'. The Telegram bot is the scriptable path.
chaining: A free unlocker with no account is the zero-cost front of a chain: paste a 1fichier or Mega link, get a direct HTTP link, hand it to aria2. It costs nothing to keep as a fallback beside a paid multi-host.

limits.value: a daily unlock limit on the free plan, removed by premium; the number is not published
daily limit on the free tier, number unpublished; premium removes it
a daily limit exists on the free tier; the number is not published

limits_note: Host coverage is named as 29 hosts plus 'mais de 25 outros', including 1Fichier, Mega, Mediafire, Rapidgator, Turbobit, K2S and DDownload.
binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the unlock count fails long before any byte allowance, because the free plan meters requests per day and publishes no byte quota at all.

identity_cost.detail: 'sem precisar de conta ou cadastro' - no account on the web form. The Telegram bot requires a Telegram account, which is a phone number, but the web path does not.

reliability_note: Ad-funded free unlockers are the least stable class: the operator pays for server bandwidth with no subscription revenue, so a daily cap or a sudden closure is the expected end. The vendor already sells ad removal as the product.
confidence_note: The free plan's terms, the account-free claim, the host list, the JDownloader path and the Telegram bot were read on the vendor's Portuguese page. The premium price is unverified: debridr.com/premium returned a 504 on both attempts, which proves nothing about the target.

notes: debridr serves a Portuguese page and an English one, with no Portuguese-language commercial content beyond the interface; it is not a Brazilian company as far as the pages read show. It is the only zero-account multi-host found that names 1fichier and Mega together. A 2026-era entrant with localised host pages (pt, ja and others), which is how it surfaced in non-English searches. It states a daily limit exists and never states its size, so it is recorded at the unverified rung rather than estimated. Its 56-host list is broad and current: it includes Fikper-era hosts such as 10drives, Cloudfam and Zincdrive alongside the older Rapidgator/K2S set. The bot is the interesting part: a chat interface removes the need for a browser session and is drivable by a wrapper through the Telegram API. Whether the bot honours the same unstated daily limit was not tested.
